title: Cancellation Refund Share and Recent Northgate Purchases
content:
On Northgate Memberships the share of the refundable current-year fees that a cancellation returns turns on whether the cancellation comes within the tier's full refund window and on whether the member has recent Northgate purchases, read from the member's purchase records in Northgate Purchases & Returns.

## Terms

- **Full refund window:** the tier's number of calendar days counted from the first day of the current membership year, that day being day 0; a cancellation on the last day of the window comes within it.

| Tier | Full refund window (calendar days) | Refund after the window for unused months |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | 30 | No |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | 90 | Yes |
| Northgate Club Membership | 90 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Membership | 60 | Yes |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 90 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 60 | Yes |

- **Recent Northgate purchases:** the member's recent Northgate purchases are the merchandise sale lines posted in the two whole months before the cancellation — sale lines dated fewer than 2 whole months before the cancellation date. The member has recent Northgate purchases when there is at least one such line.
- **Unused months:** the whole months from the cancellation date to the expiry date, a month counting only when the expiry date's day of the month has reached the cancellation date's day of the month.

## Rule

When the cancellation comes within the full refund window and the member has recent Northgate purchases, the cancellation refund share is the unused months divided by twelve. When the cancellation comes after the full refund window and the member has no recent Northgate purchases, the cancellation refund share is the whole of the refundable current-year fees. Any other cancellation takes as its share the whole of the refundable current-year fees within the full refund window, and after the window the unused months divided by twelve where the tier refunds unused months after the window and nothing where it does not.

| Cancellation | Recent Northgate purchases | Share |
|---|---|---|
| within the full refund window | Yes | unused months divided by twelve |
| within the full refund window | No | the whole |
| after the full refund window | No | the whole |
| after the full refund window | Yes | unused months divided by twelve where the tier refunds unused months after the window; nothing where it does not |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; Club membership, year 1 January to 31 December 2027)

| Cancellation date | Day | Sale lines in the two whole months before | Unused months | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20 February 2027 | 50 | one line on 5 February 2027 | 10 | 10 twelfths |
| 20 February 2027 | 50 | none | — | whole |
| 10 August 2027 | 221 | none | — | whole |
| 10 August 2027 | 221 | one line on 1 July 2027 | 4 | 4 twelfths |
| 10 August 2027 | 221 | one line on 10 June 2027 only (two whole months before) | 4 | that line is not recent: whole |
